d: Jose Mourinho has thrown a new twist into Vinicius Junior’s Real Madrid story. If he were in the Brazilian’s shoes, he says, he would have seriously considered leaving. And that’s what makes it so uncomfortable. This is a player who has endured racist abuse, fought for respect in La Liga, and still committed his future to the Santiago Bernabeu. So what does it mean when your own coach starts talking about walking away as an option? Rupha Ramani looks at the tension around Vinicius, and what Mourinho’s words really tell us.
